type-system.twistDescription: Letter spacing injection: added --font-letter-spacing-heading: 0.06em to cssVars; Overpass Mono replaced with DM Mono (concept-matched fallback)

motion-system.twistDescription: Easing curve swap: replaced Apple's symmetric ease cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) with ease-out-quad cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94) for deceleration-dominant feel

grid-system.twistDescription: Gap value scaling — expanded all rowGap and columnGap values by x1.5

spacing-system.twistDescription: Button padding shift: horizontal padding on button (+12px) and cta (+12px) elements widened

interaction-states.twistDescription: Hover transition speed — languid: 0.1s linear -> 0.35s ease-out across all elements; active states at 0.15s ease-in

nav-system.twistDescription: Underline hover animation slowed from 0.3s to 0.55s, thickened from 1px to 1.5px

concept-summary.twistDescription: Material shift: added physical materiality layer to Typography Architecture section

consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: fixed — changed nav font from Inter to Manrope (primary sans from type system)

productConcept.name: Deckle & Thread
productConcept.description: A private letterpress studio in Edinburgh specializing in hand-printed limited editions, broadside poems, artist collaborations, and bespoke typography commissions on dampened cotton rag paper using antique Vandercook presses.
productConcept.rationale: The EB Garamond + Manrope + DM Mono type pairing, warm cream palette (#f5f0e8), precision-under-restraint concept, and letterpress-quality typographic detail made a fine press studio the ideal product world. The book-page website mandate further reinforced this: a letterpress studio whose website feels like turning the pages of one of its own editions.

landingPage.animationDecision: motion-tokens — motion system has 0.7-1.04s non-trivial durations and concept_by_video.md describes scroll-triggered panel staggers and ambient video loops
landingPage.assetGenerationStatus: skipped — caller instruction 'Skip asset generation — do not run Steps 7-8'

features: Book-flip page system with GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub clip-path
Spine with convex radial gradient and stitching marks
Desk surface visible behind book (warm linen #d4c8b8)
Paper texture overlay on every page (horizontal lines, mix-blend-mode: multiply)
Fold-back showing paper fiber texture with dynamic colors
Bookmark tabs on right edge with card-stock depth
Page progress dots at bottom center
Book cover opening animation on load
Drop caps (EB Garamond 3.5em) on opening paragraphs
Endpapers with marbled CSS radial gradient pattern
